title: Use a separate `PrinterFlag` for including fix diffs
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to my review of #4528 -- I got confused about how the various flags interacted with one another, so opted to change `ecosystem_ci` from a printer argument, to something that sets a new, dedicated flag within `Printer`.

## Test Plan
